report:
Conclusion: **False.** Drinking boiled garlic water does **not** cure COVID-19. WHO says garlic is a healthy food with possible antimicrobial properties, but there is **no evidence** it protects people from COVID-19. Fact-checkers tracing the viral “boiled garlic water” recipe found no scientific proof and noted health professionals rejected it early in the pandemic. Broader reviews likewise warn there are no “miracle foods or diets” that prevent or cure COVID-19. Garlic can be part of a normal diet, but relying on it instead of testing, vaccination, medical care, or evidence-based antivirals may delay effective treatment—especially for older or high-risk people.
